title: Special Notice
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE INTELLIGENCE AGENCY (DIA).VIRGINIA CONTRACTING ACTIVITY
detail_text: Special Notice Update 07 April 2026 RFI submission deadline has been extended to April 13, 2026, at 23:59 EST This is a special notice of The Virginia Contracting Activity (VACA) release of a DIA SCIF Lifecycle Support Services RFI on NRO and NSA ARCs. Please take note of the following: - RFI submission deadline: April 09, 2026, at 23:59 PM (EST) - All qualified entities wishing to respond to the Request for Information (RFI) must comply with the instructions outlined in the NRO and NSA ARC postings. - Additionally, access to the NRO and NSA ARC is a prerequisite for RFI submissions.
